name: OIDC RBAC
description: Advanced OIDC authentication with role-based library access control
overview: OpenID Connect SSO with role-to-library mapping, multi-provider support, and admin UI.

versions.changelog:
Fix the SSO sign-in banner appearing on media item pages

The injected login-button script matched any form on any page, so the banner rendered above the audio/subtitle selectors on movie and episode pages. It now attaches only to the login form, inserts the buttons once, and stops watching the DOM afterwards. Thanks to @brianporeilly for the report and the fix.
